verdict.rationale: BAMF is a government service, so whether its core transaction (e.g. an asylum or residence application) can be completed online is a fair question. However, the evidence pack contains only informational pages: migration and residence topics, the BAMF-NAvI integration-offer finder, advisory service teams, FAQs and statistics. Nothing shows any application, registration or payment being completed online.

support.subject: As a founder, the core transaction this service exists for (form, register, apply, file, or pay) can be completed online, per the service's own published pages
